title: Verify the V6 dual-repository placement
goal: Prove burn-graph operates from Burn Workspace V6 while code, public documentation, and Product Private truth keep explicit repository boundaries.

prompt.objective: Confirm the original Git history now lives only in the V6 code repository and no Product Private tree remains inside it.
instructions: Inspect the exact repository root and tracked file set.
Treat a second active root checkout or tracked private contract as a blocker.
doneWhen: The code repository preserves its pre-migration history.
The former V5 workspace root location is absent.
No privacy/spec tree is tracked in the code repository.

prompt.objective: Validate the independent Product Private repository, V6 principle inheritance, project control schema, and every live cross-repository path.
instructions: Resolve paths from the privacy repository root.
Keep historical Evidence separate from generated runtime data.
doneWhen: The privacy repository has an independent Git root.
project.json validates and all current references exist.
No absolute home path or runtime payload is tracked.

prompt.objective: Build and install the current release from its V6 code path while proving Product Private files stay outside the package.
instructions: Use the full verification command and isolated install E2E.
Inspect archive entries instead of assuming repository boundaries affect packaging.
doneWhen: Full verification passes from the V6 code path.
No Product Private file appears in the archive.
